---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability, satellite, or frontend feature
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What problem does this solve?

Describe the situation you're in and what's currently difficult, impossible, or awkward — not the solution yet, just the problem. ("I can't do X because Y" is more useful than "add a button for X.")

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see added or changed. If it's a new satellite/reader, name the satellite and data source; if it's a new frontend feature, describe the UI and which app(s) it applies to.

## Alternatives considered

Any other ways you thought about solving this, and why you think the proposed solution above is better.

## Additional context

Anything else useful — a reference to how another tool handles the same problem, a sketch/mockup, links to relevant satellite/data-source documentation, etc.

---

For anything beyond a small, obvious addition, please expect a design discussion in this issue before a pull request — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#before-you-start).
